description: Behavior-first traceability for release-critical Construct capabilities. Entries describe observable outcomes and must be declared by each mapped test using an @capability comment.

capabilities.outcome: A user can export a compacted chat continuation and receive a readable markdown artifact inside the active project's .cx storage.
failureModes: export falls back to user-global storage for a project session
continuation layers are not rehydrated in the export
assertions: export path remains under the active temporary project's .cx/chat-sessions/exports directory
exported markdown reports the compacted continuation and re-derived static instructions

capabilities.outcome: Typed artifacts with required structure and visuals pass release validation, while unknown artifact types fail closed.
failureModes: invalid artifact type passes validation
required visual structure is omitted
assertions: known good templates pass their declared checks
unknown artifact types are rejected

capabilities.outcome: A user can ingest supported local documents into project knowledge or an explicit sibling markdown target.
failureModes: ingest writes outside the requested project target
supported documents are skipped during recursive ingest
assertions: default ingestion writes normalized markdown into project knowledge
recursive ingestion includes supported files and excludes unsupported files

capabilities.outcome: A user can generate a truthful Construct demo tape even when an optional recorder is unavailable.
failureModes: demo crashes without an external recorder
terminal tape presents an unrelated vanilla theme or bypasses Construct chat
assertions: source tape is always produced
the shipped tape drives construct chat with the Construct Cockpit theme

capabilities.outcome: A user can search project knowledge and receive hits from the active project's .cx/knowledge before bundled docs.
failureModes: project research is invisible to construct knowledge search
bundled docs outrank the user's own research for the same query
assertions: project-origin hits are returned
project hits outrank bundled Construct docs for the same query

capabilities.outcome: A user can publish a validated markdown artifact to distributable outputs with explicit gate failures when prerequisites are missing.
failureModes: invalid artifacts publish without release-gate failure
missing export tooling crashes instead of degrading
assertions: release-gate failures surface actionable messages
publish pipeline detection reports missing optional tools honestly

capabilities.outcome: A user can render or export a diagram source and always receive source output even when external renderers are absent.
failureModes: missing renderer crashes the command
rendered output is produced without source when renderer fails
assertions: construct diagram exits 0 without renderer binaries
renderer presence also yields rendered SVG

capabilities.outcome: A user can regenerate and verify AUTO-managed documentation regions without silent drift.
failureModes: AUTO regions drift without detection
regeneration is not idempotent
assertions: regenerateDocs is idempotent
check mode detects drift without writing

capabilities.outcome: Every test file is classified in a reproducible corpus inventory tied to certification gap analysis.
failureModes: inventory omits test files
summary counts diverge from on-disk files
assertions: inventory includes every tests/**/*.test.mjs file
construct audit tests --corpus passes

capabilities.outcome: Certification run records validate and skipped provider calls cannot be recorded as pass.
failureModes: invalid run schema is accepted
skipped-provider verdict is promoted to pass
assertions: fixture runs validate
skipped provider calls derive inconclusive verdicts

capabilities.outcome: construct certify run executes hermetic scenarios and records durable pass/fail/inconclusive results.
failureModes: live scenarios run without opt-in
hermetic scenarios do not persist run artifacts
assertions: hermetic scenario passes and persists
live scenario without opt-in is inconclusive
